name: You Become: Daily Motivation
description: Make a little space for growth each day. You Become brings you a fresh feed of thoughts around the areas you choose, from confidence and motivation to calm and gratitude. Save favourites, share them as images, and keep inspiration close with daily reminders and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

name: Water Fasting : Beyond
description: A premium fasting companion for preparing and tracking water fasts. Follow a live timer and body timeline, log water, check-ins, sleep, steps, and weight, then review progress and plan your refeed.

name: GLP1 Peptide Tracker: DosePlan
description: A simple companion for planning injections, tracking doses, logging side effects, and staying organized through your GLP-1 or peptide routine with clear reminders and progress history.

name: World Football Cup 2026
description: A live tournament companion for following World Cup 2026 matches, scores, groups, fixtures, lineups, timelines, stats, alerts, and knockout paths in one engaging match-day hub.

name: Alma - Daily Balance Score
description: A daily wellness companion for tracking mood, sleep, hydration, movement, and breathing. Alma turns quick check-ins into a clear Balance Score, gentle insights and a simple history that helps you understand how your days are going.

name: Money & Income - WealthBoost
description: An AI-powered money coach for building better financial habits through daily missions, progress tracking, and personalized insights.

name: Viento - Minimal Weather
description: A beautiful minimal weather app that keeps forecasts clean, readable, and beautifully focused on what matters most each day.

name: My Work Shift Planner
description: A clear shift calendar and pay tracker for work schedules. Plan shifts, manage multiple work profiles, apply rotations, get reminders and export monthly and yearly reports.

name: My Nurse Shift Planner
description: A clear shift calendar and pay tracker for nurses. Plan upcoming shifts, manage work profiles, apply rotations, get reminders and export monthly CSV/PDF reports.

name: PDF Scanner App - ProScan
description: An AI-powered mobile camera scanning app for scanning, editing, signing, locking and OCR, with no advertisements or watermarks.

name: Eye Color Cam: Live Filters
description: Transform your eye color instantly with AR. Choose from 30 shades and textures to create realistic color changes and explore your perfect look.

name: Dash Pal: GPS Speedometer
description: An all-in-one motion dashboard for driving, cycling, flying, sailing and walking that turns an iPhone into a live dashboard for every journey.

name: NeuraRush - 20 Mini Games
description: Brain-boosting mini games that challenge memory, reflexes and problem-solving abilities through quick, engaging sessions.

name: Cyphre: Brain Puzzle Rings
subtitle: Relax, focus, crack the cipher
description: A glowing ring puzzle that is easy to learn and hard to put down. Spin the rings, line up colors and symbols, and crack the vault at the center. 300 levels across 12 worlds keep adding new twists, from linked rings and gears to fog, frozen rings and a boss level at the end of every world. A new daily puzzle, five neon themes with their own music and no timer on most levels make it a calm place to think.

name: Pop Pop Aliens: Reflex Arcade
subtitle: Satisfying Tap Action Levels
description: Aliens are popping out of the craters, and only your quick taps can stop them. Build big combos across 10 colourful planets and 100 campaign levels, with a boss waiting at the end of every planet, and look before you tap: a friendly astronaut or a bomb costs you a heart. Endless mode, Daily and Weekly Challenges, game-changing power-ups and skins to collect keep every round fresh.

events.title: Halloween Night
events.text: Every Halloween, ghosts and pumpkins take over the board in a limited-time spooky mode with its own leaderboard and Halloween rewards.
events.alt: A green alien in a witch hat peeking out of its hole under a big orange moon, with bats flying around

events.title: Christmas Night
events.text: Every Christmas, snow falls over the board and gingerbread men race from crater to crater in a limited-time winter mode with its own leaderboard and Christmas rewards.
events.alt: A green alien in a Santa hat peeking out of its hole under a big moon, with snow falling and Christmas lights glowing

name: Pop Pop Piggies: Animal Puzzle
subtitle: Cute & cozy farm tap game
description: A cute, cozy animal puzzle in a hand-made paper look. Tap two or more matching animals to pop them, pop bigger groups to call in Speedy, Bomb and Royal Piggy helpers, and use your taps well to keep all three stars. 200 levels across 10 places and 17 animal friends, plus Rush, Precision, Zen and a Daily Challenge with a new twist every day. No timers in the levels and no lives to wait for.

name: Bouncy Fruits Tap Smash Frenzy
description: Smash bouncing fruits while avoiding tricky decoys, mastering combos, using shields and progressing through immersive levels.

name: Pop Pop Fruits: Tap Tap Arcade
subtitle: Cute, Easy & Satisfying Games
description: Welcome to the cutest fruit stand in town. Customers line up with their orders, the fruits pop out of the crates, and you tap exactly what each one asked for before their patience runs out. Skip the vegetable decoys, grab golden apples and other helpers, and build a combo to start a Fruit Frenzy. Travel from the orchard to the beach, the jungle and a night market in a campaign with three stars on every level, an Endless mode and a new Daily Challenge every day.
